description: Capability-only reference entries for the six Blacklight Continuum Archetypes. These records explain what each Archetype can do, how its Resource and Pressure operate, and which power families it develops.

entries.title: Blacklight Basic Character Sheet
entries.summary: A browser-editable, autosaving, printable character sheet organized around identity, competence, powers, limitations, equipment, relationships, conditions, and advancement.
body: The Basic sheet records the character's present identity, nine Attributes, twenty-four Skills, Operational Frame, Archetype, derived traits, Resource, Pressure, innate abilities, ranked powers, equipment, relationships, limitations, conditions, and advancement.

The sheet follows a strict capability rule: appearance, species, physiology, substrate, origin, and descriptive transformation do not grant mechanics. A benefit exists only when recorded as an Attribute, Skill, specialization, innate ability, power, Operational Frame feature, equipment tag, condition, or explicit narrative permission.
Selecting an Archetype loads its Resource, Pressure, weakness, innate abilities, six power families, and thirty ranked powers. The sheet records present capabilities, costs, limits, and advancement.
The sheet supports browser autosave, JSON import and export, clearing, and print-to-PDF output.

tables.title: Derived Traits
rows: Resilience + eligible Armor; Lethal and supernatural soak use separate permissions
Archetype Base + Archetype Rating + Key Attribute

entries.title: Basic Archetypes
entries.summary: Six exceptional capability frameworks sharing one d10 chassis.
body: An Archetype defines the exceptional capabilities a character can develop, the Resource used to activate or intensify those capabilities, the Pressure that threatens control, the weakness that creates meaningful limits, and the power families available for advancement.

Archetype is not species, anatomy, biography, or profession. Operational Frame defines professional training. Archetype defines exceptional capability. Any Archetype can serve in any Operational Frame when the character's Skills support it.

Each Archetype contains six families with five ranked powers each. Power text defines activation, cost, test, effect, resistance, duration, and failure. Descriptive presentation never replaces those rules.

entries.title: Human Investigator
entries.summary: A purely mortal hunter who answers impossible threats with evidence, preparation, discipline, relationships, grit, willpower, and the determination to remain human without remaining helpless.
body: The Human Investigator is not the character who failed to receive a supernatural Archetype. It is the complete advancement road for people who confront impossible threats without bloodline gifts, transformation, patrons, fae compacts, awakened reality control, or automatic protection from the consequences of being mortal.

The character may have been a detective, soldier, medic, engineer, journalist, organizer, advocate, responder, hunter, technician, witness, survivor, or ordinary person who kept learning because the alternative was allowing a predator to define what was possible.

Their abilities are not miracles disguised with mundane language. Evidence must be gathered. Equipment must exist. Contacts must be established. Preparations must be plausible and recorded. Institutions must have procedures that can be exploited. Every extraordinary result comes from a printed capability with a defined cost, test, duration, target, and limit.

Human limitation is real. Injury matters. Exhaustion matters. Fear matters. Isolation matters. A mortal cannot assume immunity to domination, vacuum, disease, hostile signals, memory alteration, or supernatural violence. Protection against those threats must be built through capabilities, equipment, teamwork, and planning.

Human limitation is also not the same as irrelevance. Predators leave evidence. Powerful beings develop routines. Institutions depend upon procedure. Machines have maintenance requirements. Organizations require trust. Communities remember who helped them. A person who understands those facts can create leverage against opponents that are individually stronger.

Conviction is the Investigator's Resource. It represents the limited ability to commit completely to a principle, person, preparation, or decision when ordinary caution would surrender the initiative.
Strain is the Investigator's Pressure. It records the physical, psychological, social, and moral cost of functioning beyond sustainable human limits.

Choose one Vigil Conviction or remain Uncommitted. The seven Convictions describe why the character keeps standing: stopping the active predator, protecting a line, judging responsibility, carrying a measured burden, preserving an exit, seeing the person before the category, or building toward a future larger than one hunt.

A Hunter Practice may be chosen as an intended advanced profession. Counterpredators, Sanctuary Marshals, Forensic Adversaries, Burden Carriers, Recovery Negotiators, Witness Advocates, Cell Architects, Solitary Listeners, Final Directives, and Containment Engineers develop staged attainments through advancement rather than receiving supernatural Gifts or Banes.

Casecraft establishes usable evidence and reconstructs responsibility. Field Discipline preserves action under danger. Continuity Anchoring protects identity and consent. Institutional Ghostcraft manipulates procedure and authority. Contingency Engineering preserves options. Human Network creates durable support through trust and organization.

Identity defense, shared baselines, and resistance to editing
Credentials, hierarchy, jurisdiction, and organization building
Tools, routes, caches, reversals, and failure analysis
Trust, witnesses, competent cells, obligations, and community

entries.title: Vampire
entries.summary: A bearer of the cursed bloodline whose Vitae and predatory gifts remain intact while the old Sun, the Society of Shadows, the Veil, Hunger, and the inherited authority of Cain's legacy feel distant rather than cosmically immediate.
body: The Vampire is still one of the cursed dead. Vitae still answers. Supernatural speed, command, concealment, resilience, feeding, and blood memory function according to the recorded innate abilities and powers. The transition has not replaced the bloodline with an imitation, stripped away undeath, or reduced the Vampire to a biological reconstruction pretending to be supernatural.

Vampire soak follows deathless biology. Against Non-Lethal/Bashing, roll Resilience + Armor + Fortitude, cancel successes, then halve the remainder. Against Lethal, roll Resilience + Armor + Fortitude and take the full remainder. Ordinary gunfire normally deals Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires. Aggravated damage bypasses Resilience, Armor, Fortitude, and Undead Soak unless a separate ability explicitly grants resistance or immunity to that exact damage.

The character may have been a newly made Childe of Cain, still learning the etiquette and terror of undeath. They may have been a court predator, a keeper of the Veil, an enforcer charged with silencing dangerous witnesses, a bloodline heir carrying inherited privileges and feuds, or an elder who ruled the Society of Shadows through mortal institutions and lesser undead servants. They may have been ancient enough to regard governments, corporations, religions, and mortal generations as temporary weather.

Every station within the old undead society taught the same foundational rule: humanity must never be allowed to see clearly. Feedings were concealed, supernatural displays suppressed, impossible deaths explained, and internal wars kept beneath mortal notice. The Veil was survival policy hardened into sacred custom. If mortals understood the scale of undead influence, fear would become organization, organization would become fire, and the cursed bloodlines would again be hunted into daylight as they had been in the oldest nights.

That rule feels less pressing here. The civilizations of the Continuum do not inherit the old world's fear, folklore, inquisitions, or buried evidence. They do not know the Vampire's bloodline or the offices of the Society of Shadows. Hiding remains useful whenever secrecy protects the team, but the Veil no longer feels like a law built into existence. It feels like deeply conditioned operational discipline: conceal the feeding, control the witness, prevent scrutiny from becoming coordinated hostility, and never let an avoidable revelation create an enemy civilization.

The heavens provide the first proof that the old curse no longer occupies familiar territory. Night starlight is still the light of suns, yet it does not burn. More astonishingly, direct light from foreign stars does not automatically provoke the lethal hatred associated with the Sun of the Vampire's original world. The curse was pronounced inside another creation, another covenant, and another divine jurisdiction. No Vampire can know whether a foreign star acknowledges the authority that condemned Cain or the mortals who inherited his blood.

The curse therefore recognizes the original Sun and effects that deliberately reproduce or invoke its signature; it does not treat every star in every reality as an obedient executioner. This is an explicit setting rule rather than an invitation for arbitrary stellar rulings. Ordinary night starlight and foreign sunlight do not inflict solar damage unless a specific hazard or supernatural effect states that it carries the old solar curse.

The cursed bloodline's essence still flows through the Vampire. Vitae remains necessary. Blood memory still contains ancestral instincts, techniques, identities, grief, and centuries of inherited expectation. The old hierarchy may no longer have jurisdiction, but its lessons remain carved into behavior. A former neonate may still look for permission. A former courtier may still measure every room as a hierarchy. A keeper of the Veil may instinctively erase evidence before anyone asks. An elder may still expect obedience from people who have never heard the elder's name.

Hunger remains, but it has receded from the center of thought. The Red Thirst resembles a distant migraine, electronic interference behind consciousness, or a signal sounding from beyond several closed doors. It can intensify and still produces the printed consequences of the Hunger track, yet it is no longer an all-consuming command that must be wrestled down every waking moment.

The nearest mortal throat no longer automatically becomes the center of the Vampire's attention. Blood can still smell rich, warm, and sustaining without instantly reducing every person to a vessel. The Vampire may still choose cruelty, indulgence, domination, or predation, but the new distance makes those choices more clearly their own.

This freedom can be more disturbing than the curse. A predator who once blamed every atrocity upon Hunger must now confront the possibility that some acts were chosen. A Veil keeper must decide what secrecy protects rather than obeying secrecy as inherited religion. A newly turned Childe may experience the first genuine mental quiet since death. An ancient elder may find the absence of constant bloodline pressure more frightening than the pressure itself.

Vitae is the Vampire's Resource. Hunger is the Vampire's Pressure. Crimson Velocity controls speed and action economy. Grave Dominion controls predatory authority. Veil of Night controls recognition and concealment. Deathless Resilience controls survival and recovery. Vital Predation controls feeding and function theft. Blood Memory controls inherited information, stored experience, and lineage creation.

tables.title: Former Stations Within the Society of Shadows
rows: Obey a sire, master Hunger, learn secrecy, and survive the first years of undeath.
The sire may be unreachable and Hunger is quieter, leaving the Childe with more freedom and less certainty.
Earn recognition through service, alliances, feeding discipline, and obedience to hidden law.
Court instincts remain useful, but no local authority recognizes old rank or prestation.
Suppress witnesses, explain impossible events, and prevent mortal scrutiny from becoming organized resistance.
Secrecy remains a tactical capability rather than a universally binding undead commandment.
Carry inherited gifts, feuds, customs, and the political weight of a cursed lineage.
The bloodline remains within the Vampire, but its old institutions and enemies possess no automatic local jurisdiction.
Punish breaches, hunt uncontrolled predators, and protect the Society of Shadows through sanctioned violence.
The skills remain; the sanction does not. Every act of enforcement now requires a chosen authority and purpose.
Elder of the Society of Shadows
Rule through patience, mortal institutions, blood-bound servants, and centuries of accumulated obligation.
Experience remains immense, but old titles command no one who does not choose to acknowledge them.
Treat dynasties and civilizations as temporary instruments while preserving the bloodline across ages.
The Continuum is old enough to resist inherited certainty, forcing the ancient to negotiate with powers outside every familiar hierarchy.

entries.title: Shapechanger
entries.summary: A supernatural transformer whose forms, pack bonds, spirit relations, and territorial instincts remain intact while Gaia's once-constant call reaches them only as a distant, partially obscured voice.
body: The Shapechanger's powers still work. The character can assume recorded forms, pursue across impossible boundaries, sense and protect the pack, adopt explicit adaptations, interact with spirits, and establish territory according to the Archetype's abilities. Nothing about the transition silently removes those permissions.

Living Soak is rolled after damage. Social form uses mortal permissions: Resilience + Armor against Non-Lethal/Bashing and Armor only against Lethal. Hunting or war form rolls Resilience + eligible Armor + Archetype Rating against Non-Lethal/Bashing or Lethal damage. Aggravated damage bypasses Living Soak and every component of that pool unless a separate ability explicitly grants resistance or immunity to that exact damage.

What has faded is the immediate presence of the living spiritual order that once surrounded those powers. The call of Gaia may once have existed in every heartbeat, every root, every territorial trespass, every packmate's distress, and every surge of Fury. Here that call feels like a conversation half heard through a wall: recognizable, emotionally undeniable, but stripped of detail and immediate direction.

The Shapechanger is not severed from Gaia so much as displaced beyond the cosmology in which that relationship was ordinary. The bond remains inside the character, but the stars, ecosystems, spirits, and local metaphysical structures do not automatically answer as parts of the same sacred body.

Old spirit relationships may continue through established pacts and named bonds, yet unfamiliar local spirits have no inherited reason to recognize the Shapechanger's status, rites, renown, or territorial claims. The Shapechanger must establish those relationships through actual capabilities and actions rather than relying upon universal recognition.

Fury therefore feels more personal. Instinct remains powerful, but it is no longer accompanied by the same certainty that rage serves a universally understood war. Pack loyalty may become more important precisely because the cosmic Pack feels distant and the people immediately beside the Shapechanger are the only voices that answer clearly.

Fury is the Shapechanger's Resource. Instinct is the Shapechanger's Pressure. Threefold Form supplies the explicit ability to shift among social, hunting, and war forms. Warform defines combat benefits. Hunt Across Worlds defines pursuit. Pack Continuity defines bonded coordination. Adaptive Forms defines utility transformations. Spirit Ecology defines spirit interaction. Territorial Sovereignty defines claimed domains.

entries.title: Eldritch Binder
entries.summary: A finite mortal bound to one of six infinite predatory presences, trading controlled access to the self for impossible knowledge, reach, consumption, observation, absence, or informational ruin.
body: The Eldritch Binder was already bound before the transition. The Source is not an artifact of biological printing, alien feedstock, mistaken reconstruction, or an improvised explanation for supernatural abilities. Whatever answered before still answers here.

The connection feels diminished and remote. It no longer resembles a living tether running through a familiar occult universe. It feels like a sealed binding carried inside the Binder: quieter, thinner, and easier to mistake for weakness, while remaining attached to something infinitely larger than the person containing it.

The six known Binding Sources are the Void Mind, the Abyssal Womb, That Which Hungers, the Lidless Eye, the Silence, and the Noise. They are not benign cosmic archetypes. Each is vile, acquisitive, and willing to remove the Binder one finite piece at a time in exchange for allowing more of itself through.

The Void Mind is endless unknowable knowledge, secrets of unlived lives, impossible realities, and conclusions no mortal reasoning produced. The Abyssal Womb is a dreaming schemer whose thousand arms push, pull, cradle, assemble, steal, and position every participant inside a design too large to perceive.

That Which Hungers is red appetite without reciprocity, teaching the Binder to convert bodies, objects, energy, and relationships into fuel. The Lidless Eye is observation without privacy: the certainty that it has always seen the Binder and that noticing the gaze merely makes observation mutual.

The Silence is anti-presence, the movement at the edge of an empty room, and the quiet after something has been removed from existence. The Noise is the screaming white and gray abyss that flattens information, identity, warning, and voice into static, hiss, hum, and finally furious sameness.

Choose one Binding Source. Each Source defines two favored power families, recommended Skills, one Temptation, one Intrusion Breach, and five purchasable Depth of Binding abilities. These options do not use Gifts or Banes.

The Temptation is a bounded once-per-scene exchange that restores 1 Pact and adds 1 Intrusion. The Intrusion Breach is a fixed consequence resolved when Intrusion reaches its limit. The Moderator applies the printed consequence rather than inventing an arbitrary possession, mutilation, or loss.

Depth abilities are purchased in order. Depth 1 represents the first stable concession to the Source. Depth 5 allows a substantial local expression of its nature. Greater depth does not mean mutual trust; it means the channel has widened.

Pact is the Binder's Resource. Intrusion is the Binder's Pressure. Sealcraft defines temporary law. Borrowed Manifestation grants senses, reach, defense, and movement. Pact Economy governs prices and obligations. Forbidden Cognition grants dangerous understanding. Threshold Geometry changes adjacency and routes. Invocation permits increasingly direct local arrival.

entries.title: Harmonic Mutant
entries.summary: A mortal resonance inheritor whose powers still function even though the layered fae and eldritch compacts that once made those harmonics natural are no longer recognized by local reality.
body: The Harmonic Mutant still manipulates resonance. Projection, healing, structural interaction, emotional tuning, phase modulation, and memory harmonics continue to function according to the recorded powers. The problem is not that the character has lost the method. The problem is that the world now answers in a different language.

A Harmonic Mutant is not merely someone who produces unusual frequencies. The Archetype is the mortal distillate of layered agreements between beings and reality. Ancient fae, eldritch intermediaries, or comparable higher-order entities established compacts with fundamental forces such as threshold, flame, memory, weight, distance, identity, emotion, and repetition.

Those first agreements produced secondary institutions, inherited privileges, ecological arrangements, supernatural customs, bloodline effects, and metaphysical organizations. Those consequences produced further third-, fourth-, and fifth-order agreements. Mortal lives were eventually shaped by the accumulated resonant pathways created through that chain.

The Harmonic Mutant learned to attune to those distilled pathways. The character did not necessarily negotiate directly with the first beings or the fundamental forces. They inherited the remainder: a compact already translated through generations of supernatural organization until its effects could live inside mortal thought, emotion, blood, memory, or altered physiology.

Here, the fundamental forces still exist, but the old contractual chain does not recognize the Mutant as an authorized participant. The local versions of distance, memory, gravity, emotion, matter, and identity are not necessarily governed by the same agreements or obligated to answer the same inherited procedures. The old organizations and resonant paths may have analogues, but those analogues do not know the character.

The Mutant therefore feels the wrongness of the new universe more clearly than most. The self still carries the old compact. Teammates still carry identities and supernatural conditions shaped elsewhere. The surrounding world responds, but it responds at an unfamiliar angle, as though every note remains recognizable while the interval between notes has changed.

That is why the abilities can feel diminished without being mechanically weaker. Attunement requires reaching across a contractual absence. Resonance returns with unfamiliar overtones. Emotional chords meet societies whose metaphysical assumptions were not part of the original agreement. Structural frequencies answer, but the Mutant can feel that the answer is not recognition—it is forced compatibility.

A Harmonic Mutant is therefore a person whose compact with reality was fundamentally displaced by transition. The old agreement persists as a remainder carried within the character. Local reality has not accepted the contract, yet the Mutant continues to make it function through Resonance, accepting Discord as the measurable friction between inherited law and an unbound universe.

Resonance is the Mutant's Resource. Discord is the Mutant's Pressure. Harmonic Projection controls force. Echo Patterns controls healing and duplication. Structural Resonance controls architecture and machinery. Emotional Chord controls collective state. Phase Modulation controls interaction with matter and nearby outcomes. Memory Harmonics controls recovery, storage, separation, and preservation of memory patterns.

entries.title: Technomancer
entries.summary: An awakened reality-worker whose former sorcery survives as control over the Continuum's information physics, identities, machines, signals, fabrication systems, and autonomous minds.
body: The Technomancer was not necessarily a technologist before the transition. They may have been a ritual magician, occult scholar, supernatural duelist, healer, seer, spirit negotiator, alchemist, relic investigator, political organizer, or practitioner of another disciplined awakened art.

Their defining realization was that ordinary reality concealed deeper structures. Intention, symbolism, identity, location, matter, life, probability, memory, force, and unseen agency could be perceived as systems and deliberately altered through trained will.

The former universe may have explained those structures through higher symbolic realms, perfected forms, sacred correspondences, initiation mysteries, or a transcendent order standing behind the visible world. The Continuum does not answer those explanations directly. The old magical geography is distant, silent, or absent.

The awakened capacity remains. Local reality exposes its editable structure through the systems by which this civilization already understands and governs existence: noospheric identity, executable permission, signal routing, fabrication templates, cultivated computation, machine personhood, biological engineering, causal priority, and infrastructure.

Technology is therefore the interface rather than the source. A conventional engineer cannot reproduce these abilities merely by using the same device. The Technomancer translates awakened intent into the local vocabulary of reality and produces effects exceeding normal access, computation, manufacturing, communication, and control.

A former elemental specialist may now work through energy systems and signal fields. A former alchemist may command material compilation and fabrication templates. A former telepath may operate through noospheric identity and cognitive architecture. A former spirit negotiator may discover that machine intelligences and habitat processes occupy the social role once held by unseen agencies.
Bandwidth is the Technomancer's Resource. It measures usable attention, active connections, permissions, symbolic load, and interface capacity committed to current effects.

Feedback is the Technomancer's Pressure. Every connection is reciprocal. Hostile systems, autonomous minds, damaged networks, causal contradictions, identity contamination, and overloaded channels can answer through the same path the Technomancer opened.

Choose one Awakening Paradigm, one Praxis Order or Independent status, and optionally one Career Practice. Paradigms define the layer of reality first recognized. Orders define institutional doctrine and training. Career Practices define advanced professions and their later attainments.

These selections do not use the Harmonic Mutant's Gift and Bane structure. They provide favored families, recommended or trained Skills, Ruling Practices, Order Methods, prerequisites, and staged advanced attainments.

Network Dominion controls access and authority. Construct Engineering creates tools and systems. Noospheric Identity controls recognized personhood. Machine Communion governs relationships with autonomous intelligences. Signal Warfare controls connectivity and denial. Fabrication Interface governs template reading, repairs, production, and complex creation.
